information.name: routeros-suspension-comsat
information.description: Plugin for handling suspension on RouterOS devices. Resolves each client's IP address(es) from a CLIENT custom attribute (e.g. the one filled by ip-address-sync/quesync-comsat) instead of the Network (NMS) app.
information.author: xingginto

configuration.label: IP Address Custom Attribute Name
configuration.description: The exact name of the CLIENT custom attribute holding the client's IP address(es) (default: IP Address). Multiple IPs may be comma-separated; all are blocked/unblocked together.

configuration.label: IP Address
configuration.description: IP address of Mikrotik gateway. For more gateways you can use multiple configuration values in IP Address, User name and Password fields. Just put each value on a new line. The number and order of rows must be consistent in all filled fields.

configuration.label: Subnet to sync
configuration.description: Subnet(s) to sync per device. One line per device, matching the order of the IP Address field. Separate multiple subnets on the same line with commas, e.g. 192.168.0.0/24,192.168.8.0/24. Leave a line blank to sync all IPs to that device.

configuration.label: Captive Portal IP address
configuration.description: IP address of the captive portal VM (e.g. 192.168.99.113). Blocked users will have DNS, HTTP and HTTPS redirected here. This IP is automatically included in the walled garden.

configuration.label: Walled Garden IPs
configuration.description: Additional IP addresses blocked users may reach freely (e.g. payment portal IPs). One IP per line. The Captive Portal IP is always included automatically.

configuration.label: Server Timezone
configuration.description: PHP timezone for date calculations. Must match your UISP timezone setting (e.g. Asia/Singapore, Asia/Manila, America/New_York). Leave blank to use UTC.
